subject: Civic Education
preamble: This syllabus aims at assessing the candidate's ability to understand the importance of citizenship in the society; explain the structure, functions, and responsibilities of government to the people; know emerging issues in the society; understand the rights, duties, and obligations of citizens to government and society; and appreciate democratic values and strive to uphold them.
aims: understand the importance of citizenship in society;
explain the structure, functions, and responsibilities of government to the people;
know emerging issues in the society;
understand the rights, duties, and obligations of citizens to government and society;
appreciate democratic values and strive to uphold them.

examination_scheme.summary: There will be two papers, Paper 1 and Paper 2; both of which will be in a composite paper and will be taken at one sitting.

papers.title: Multiple Choice Objective Test
papers.details: A 1-hour multiple choice test consisting of fifty questions drawn from the entire syllabus.

papers.title: Essay Paper
papers.details: A 2-hour essay-type test consisting of three sections (Sections A, B, and C) with three questions each. Candidates must answer four questions, choosing at least one from each section.

detailed_syllabus.section_name: National Ethics, Discipline, Rights and Obligations

topics.title: 1. Values
topics.notes: Definition, types, and importance of values to the society.

topics.title: 2. Citizenship and Nationalism
topics.notes: Meaning of citizenship and citizenship education; goals of citizenship education; duties and obligations of citizens; meaning of nationalism; ways of promoting national consciousness, integrity, and unity in society; nationalistic roles of individuals and groups; identification of local and world civic problems.

topics.title: 3. Human Rights
topics.notes: Meaning, categories, and characteristics of human rights; historical background and importance of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR); seven core freedoms of UDHR; roles of individuals, groups, and government in promoting UDHR; limitations to human rights.

topics.title: 4. Law and Order
topics.notes: Definition, features, and importance of law and order in society; meaning, types, importance, and roles of constituted authority.

topics.title: 5. Responsible Parenthood
topics.notes: Meaning of responsible parenthood; roles of responsible parents; importance of responsible parenthood in national development.

topics.title: 6. Traffic Regulations
topics.notes: Meaning and importance of traffic regulations in society; roles of individuals and government in maintaining traffic regulations.

topics.title: 7. Inter-Personal and Inter-Communal Relationships
topics.notes: Meaning, types, and skills promoting inter-personal relationships; meaning, importance, and resolution skills for inter-communal relationships and conflicts.

topics.title: 8. Cultism
topics.notes: Meaning, origin, causes, and consequences of cultism; prominent cult groups and their symbols in Nigeria; preventive measures against cultism in society.

topics.title: 9. Drugs and Drug Abuse
topics.notes: Meaning of drug abuse; commonly abused drugs and methods of abuse; symptoms and behaviors of drug addicts; prevention strategies; government agencies fighting drug trafficking/abuse (e.g., NDLEA) and relevant anti-drug laws.

topics.title: 10. Human Trafficking
topics.notes: Meaning, causes, effects, and consequences of human trafficking; government and individual efforts towards curbing human trafficking.

topics.title: 11. HIV/AIDS
topics.notes: Meaning, causes, symptoms, effects, and prevention of HIV/AIDS; addressing stigmatization of people living with HIV/AIDS.

topics.title: 12. Youth Empowerment
topics.notes: Meaning, importance, and benefits of youth empowerment; key empowerment skills; government programs and initiatives towards youth empowerment.

topics.title: 13. Structure and Functions of Government
topics.notes: Meaning, structure, tiers, and core functions of government.

topics.title: 14. Democracy, Rule of Law and National Development
topics.notes: Meaning, types, features, pillars, and problems of democracy; concept, features, importance, and challenges of the Rule of Law; role of democracy and Rule of Law in driving national development (good governance, employment creation, poverty alleviation).

topics.title: 15. Political Apathy
topics.notes: Meaning, causes, and consequences of political apathy; reasons leaders fail to protect followers' interests and remedies; strategies for discouraging political apathy.

topics.title: 16. Civil Society and Popular Participation
topics.notes: Meaning, types, importance, and modes (traditional and modern) of popular participation; achieving political participation; meaning, functions, qualities (accountability, justice, equity), and challenges (corruption, donor influence) of civil society.

topics.title: 17. Public Service in Democracy
topics.notes: Meaning, functions, problems, and shortcomings of the public service; strategic measures for improving public service delivery.
